LanguageData.LP_MinotaurCharge.label: bull rush
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurCharge.description: The minotaur lowers its head and charges straight up to 8 cells like a bull. The first enemy hit takes about 15 blunt damage (scaled up by the minotaur's body size, about 20 for a minotaur), is knocked back 2 cells and stunned for 1 second. Stops on hitting a wall or building without damaging it; friendly and neutral people block the way. Cooldown 1 day.
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurHorns.label: horns
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurHorns.description: A pair of thick curved bull horns on the head, replacing the ordinary skull shape. The horns can be used directly to gore in melee: sharp damage slightly higher than fists, but the head swing is a little slower.
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurHorns.customEffectDescription: Gains the "horns" melee attack: sharp (stab) 11 damage, cooldown 2.6 seconds (fists are 8.2 damage, 2 seconds).
Mutually exclusive with vanilla skull genes (mini horns, unihorn, etc.).
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurSnout.label: bull nose
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurSnout.description: A wide, moist bull nose with big nostrils. Purely cosmetic.
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurMaze.label: labyrinth sense
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurMaze.description: Minotaurs are born in labyrinths and are in their element in places enclosed by walls and roofs. Move speed +10% while standing on a roofed cell.
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurStature.label: minotaur build
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurStature.description: The burly minotaur build. Actual body size 130% of an ordinary person (carry capacity and caravan load go up, and they're easier to hit at range), drawn at 115% size; hand hauling capacity about 150% of an ordinary person. The huge body also means eating one and a half times as much as normal, with a bigger stomach (giant stomach: max food ×130%), so one meal lasts longer. The bigger the body, the stronger the health and melee (see giant-body rules: total health ×115%, melee damage ×109%).
LanguageData.LP_MinotaurStature.customEffectDescripti: Actual body size: ×130% (multiplies with other body size effects).
Hauling capacity: about 150% of an ordinary person (body size ×130% then ×115%).
Appetite: ×120%; together with the minotaur's overall metabolism -1 (vanilla ×125%), about 150% of an ordinary person.
